Bill.title: Bill
Bill.description: Completed wholesale Mandi weighment bill and thermal receipt record.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the Mandi operator who created the bill.

billNumber.description: Human-readable sequential or timestamped bill identifier (e.g. MND-20261118-001).

customerName.description: Customer or Beopari name (defaults to Cash Buyer).

itemName.description: Commodity or produce item name (defaults to Potato / Aloo).

weights.description: Individual bag weights in kilograms (1 to 500 entries).

totalBags.description: Total number of weighed bags (matches weights.size).

totalWeightKg.description: Sum of all individual bag weights in kilograms.

ratePerMann.description: Mojoda rate per 40 kg Mann in Rupees.

finalCost.description: Final payable amount calculated as (totalWeightKg * ratePerMann) / 40.

/bills/{billId}.description: Top-level collection of operator-owned Mandi weighment bills scoped by userId.
